gaps.sentence: 'I can swim,' the boy boasted. The boy boasted that he ___ swim.
gaps.explanation: Can backshifts to could in reported speech.

gaps.sentence: 'I have to catch the last train,' she said. She said she ___ catch the last train.
gaps.explanation: Have to (obligation) backshifts to had to after a past reporting verb.

gaps.sentence: 'I've been studying all night,' she said. She said she ___ studying all night.
gaps.hint: present perfect continuous → past perfect continuous
gaps.explanation: have been + -ing backshifts to had been + -ing.

gaps.sentence: 'When did the ancient city fall?' we asked the guide. We asked the guide when the ancient city ___.
gaps.explanation: did...fall → had fallen: the auxiliary 'did' disappears and the verb backshifts.

gaps.sentence: 'Sit down, please,' the nurse said to me. The nurse asked me ___ down.
gaps.explanation: Requests are reported with ask + object + to-infinitive: asked me to sit down.

gaps.sentence: The witness ___ the police that he knew nothing.
gaps.explanation: Tell somebody that... — the personal object 'the police' requires told, not said.

gaps.sentence: 'Get out of my way!' the guard snapped. The guard snapped at me ___ out of my way.
gaps.hint: snap at sb to do sth
gaps.explanation: The order is reported as snapped at me + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: "Where do you live?" — He asked me where I ___.
